management_steps.action: Assess Airway & Prepare for difficult airway
management_steps.details: Stridor, drooling, dyspnoea are red flags. Double surgical setup ready.
If ACE-I induced (Bradykinin-mediated): Adrenaline, steroids, antihistamines are ineffective. Give Tranexamic Acid 1g IV over 10 min + FFP 2 units.
